children.text: If the player is channeling, try to expand AoE objects.

children.name: overlappingWall
children.comment: Is the AoE overlapping a wall?

children.text: Check if the AoE object is overlapping an obstacle.
Check if AoE object is overlapping a metal cube.
If the cube has fallen down, act as a wall.
Otherwise try to push or pull it.
If there is a solid collider blocking the metal cube from moving, do nothing.
If the AoE object is not overlapping a wall, keep increasing its size.
AoEs overlapping cubes change size according to the metal cubes position.
Check the current state of the pressure plates.
Make player step on pressure plates.
If the player beat the game, restart from the first stage.
Otherwise, start from the current stage.
